semantic_boundary: This is a research N/V mapping. It does not convert PTB-XL record-level labels into beat labels and does not establish a clinical diagnosis.

source_label_definitions.N: normal beat; explicitly named non_VEB source label
source_label_definitions.S: supraventricular ectopic beat; explicitly named non_VEB source label for this binary task, reported separately
source_label_definitions.V: ventricular ectopic beat / VEB; positive class
source_label_definitions.Q: unknown, paced, or otherwise unclassifiable source beat; excluded from loss and metric denominators but counted

source_support_required.S: report support, confusion contribution, and S-specific error rate separately
source_support_required.V: report support and VEB sensitivity/precision contribution
source_support_required.Q: report count and exclusion reason; never put into loss or performance denominators

reporting_mapping.unknown_or_unclassifiable_policy: do not silently map to non_VEB; emit UNCLASSIFIED_BEAT or an explicit exclusion/error record

wfdb_ec57_style.mapping_source: authorized ANSI/AAMI EC57:2012/(R)2020 text plus frozen WFDB implementation notes

change_control: Any label or exclusion change requires a new contract_version and run_id; existing records are immutable.
